full_prompt_en: A square anime fantasy illustration shows two white-haired figures in dark clothing against a turbulent magenta haze. The nearer figure fills the right half, leaning forward with spiky pale hair and a broad black band covering the eyes. Its nose and tightly set mouth emerge from shadow, while the high dark collar and coat shoulders form an angular black-blue mass. Both hands cup a glowing pink-white orb near the lower center. Threads of fiery light and dark smoky tendrils curl around the sphere and illuminate the fingers from below. Behind on the left, a second pale-haired figure wears small round dark glasses and a similarly high-collared black coat. That figure looks intently toward the light and holds one hand open at the lower left, with faint hot pink glow around the palm. The background has no literal location; it is built from rough, sweeping crimson and violet strokes that make the air feel charged. Strong magenta light catches the outer edges of hair, shoulders, and gloves, leaving large inner coat areas almost black. The central orb is the brightest point, washing the nearby hands and lower faces with warm peach-pink reflections. A few sharply drawn facial planes and folds remain visible inside the broad painterly shadows. Hair strands are pulled into directional spikes, and the two bodies overlap diagonally, guiding attention from the rear figure's gaze toward the orb. No readable text appears. The overall composition is compact and volatile, with hot pink atmosphere pressing against dark forms and a single glowing center creating dramatic supernatural tension.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形动画奇幻插图呈现两名白发人物，身穿深色衣服，置于翻涌的洋红色雾气之前。较近人物占据右半部，身体前倾，浅色头发尖锐竖起，宽阔黑带遮住双眼。鼻子和紧闭的嘴从阴影中浮出，高领与外套肩部形成棱角分明的蓝黑体块。双手在下方中央捧着一颗粉白色发光球。火焰般细光和深色烟雾卷丝围绕球体，从下方照亮手指。左侧后方，第二名浅发人物戴着小圆深色眼镜，穿相似的黑色高领外套。此人凝视光团，在左下方摊开一只手，掌边有微弱炽粉光。背景没有具体地点，而是由粗糙扫出的深红与紫色笔痕构成，使空气像带了电。强洋红色光照在发丝、肩膀和手套外缘，让外套内部大片区域近乎黑色。中央球体是最亮点，以暖桃粉反光冲亮附近的手和脸下半部。少量清楚描出的面部平面和褶皱仍在宽阔绘画阴影中可见。头发拉成有方向感的尖束，两个人体斜向重叠，把注意力从后方人物的目光引向球体。画中没有可读文字。整体构图紧凑而躁动，炽粉色空气压向深色形体，一处发光中心制造强烈超自然张力。
style_prompt_en: The anime illustration combines sharp focal linework with rough expressive paint and smoke-like marks. Hot magenta, crimson, and violet saturate the atmosphere, while near-black indigo shapes create a heavy counterweight. One compact pink-white glow lights nearby surfaces from below and sends colored rim light across selected outer edges. Forms overlap diagonally, and energetic short strokes pull the eye toward the brightest center. Some facial planes and folds are crisply legible, but other boundaries dissolve into colored haze, giving the frame both graphic force and painterly motion. The overall effect is intense, supernatural, and cinematic, built from concentrated luminosity against broad shadow.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅动画插图把锐利焦点线条与粗糙表现性颜料、烟状笔痕结合。炽洋红、深红和紫色浸满空气，近黑靛蓝形体形成沉重对抗。一处紧凑粉白发光从下方照亮邻近表面，并在选定外缘送出有颜色的边光。形体沿斜线重叠，富有能量的短笔痕把视线拉向最亮中心。一些面部平面和衣褶清楚可辨，其他边界却消融进彩色烟雾，使画面同时具有图形力量和绘画运动感。整体效果强烈、超自然且有电影感，建立在集中亮光与宽阔阴影的对照上。
theme_en: Two white-haired figures shaping a glowing orb in a magenta haze
theme_zh: 洋红色雾中两名白发人物操纵发光球体
name: Jujutsu Kaisen
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
